notes.title: Playtest starts this Thursday!
notes.content: [p]We just got the green light from Steam — our build has been approved! That means it's almost time. See you in the game soon![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268610/88a3114328aeb7abfb3b38ebb24a8112daf58143.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: ALPHA IS HERE + DISCORD WITH PRIZES!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! 

To share your thoughts and chat with us directly, we're launching our official Discord server!

Join here: [url="https://discord.com/invite/metacraft-arena"]https://discord.com/invite/metacraft-arena[/url]

What's inside: 
- Direct chat with the developers 
- A channel for bug reports and feedback 
- Regular giveaways 

Come on in, we'd love to have you![/p]
